sara-kays/profile.content:
A place to begin.

Try this listening route when you want an intimate, reflective corner of pop. Start with a single song, notice the details that catch your attention, and follow the recommendations at your own pace.

This is an original editorial listening prompt for the demo, not a verified biography or a factual description of the artist’s intentions. Genre and mood tags are provisional editorial groupings. No country, career history, release date, quotation, or official social account has been asserted.

Follow your own connection.

Try listening once without looking for an explanation. On the second pass, notice the sound, the space, and your own response. The related artists below are hand-selected starting points for comparison, rather than a claim that the artists are affiliated.
